program.section_heading: SPANISH FOR TRANSFER — Associate in Arts in Spanish for Transfer (ADT)
outcomes: Demonstrate practical fluency through basic object identification, response to questions, and dialog prompts; and second-year ACTFL-level conversations in paired and group discussions.
Demonstrate higher level grammar constructs through debate and advanced composition, including the indicative as well as the rhetorical moods.
Relate the similarities and identify the differences between their own and Hispanic cultures.

notes: Substitution rule: if a student enters the sequence at SPAN-101B, a List A course must be substituted for SPAN-101A; List A then requires one course not already used for substitution (so a student may take both CHS-101 and CHS-106).
